verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll platform, so this story applies to it. However, the evidence never mentions hourly time entries, timesheets, or overtime flowing into a payroll run. The only related material is a generic claim about pushing 'payroll inputs' via the API and time-off (PTO) request handling. Neither shows that hourly time or overtime feeds payroll, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.
